description: This file is a shell script used for uploading logs, including stress-ng logs, to a remote server via HTTP or HTTPS. It includes functions for logging, handling TLS connections, and managing log uploads with retries and cleanup.

methods.name: uploadLog
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp to the DCM_LOG_FILE.

methods.name: logTLSError
methods.description: Logs TLS connection errors based on curl error codes.

methods.name: sendTLSSSRRequest
methods.description: Attempts to establish a TLS connection to the SSR server using curl.

methods.name: HttpLogUpload
methods.description: Uploads logs via HTTP/HTTPS, handles retries, and uploads to S3 if applicable.

methods.name: uploadLogOnReboot
methods.description: Handles log upload process during reboot, including cleanup.
